title: MY TURN: No vote on Ballot Measure 2 would support construction industry
description: Lots of Alaskans have a stake in open primaries and dark money disclosure laws. However, I would argue that construction workers have the most at stake, and for the sake of our jobs I strongly urge a “No” vote on Ballot Measure 2. What do open primaries, ranked choice, and dark money disclosure have to do with our jobs? It’s pretty simple: Open primaries and campaign transparency mean that the best candidates can run and win, defeating demagogues who promise the world but end up wrecking the state budget. Construction workers depend on fiscal stability and a pro-jobs environment. Fundamentally, good government is good for jobs.
